tool_args.rationale: The five observations support the siphon family but leave a genuine branch ambiguity. The open-branch discriminating probe costs less than the fine trajectory batch needed to identify the coupled ODE and directly targets the unresolved distinction.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer inland-hub siphon with an open square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied rows and pilot signatures support the siphon base, but do not determine the branch sign or distinguish a square-root branch from mass-drift leakage.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer siphon with linear leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Also compatible with the current observations; the open-branch probe is the least-cost way to discriminate branch behavior.

considered_alternatives.option: Coupled memory ODE or dual-horizon adaptation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The verified signatures and H=0.6 observations point to a monotone concave static siphon rather than these time-dependent mechanisms.
